title: Certify a plan from complementary slackness
heading: Complementary Slackness Certifies a Plan Without a Solver
cases: the optimal plan gets the prices that prove it, and a feasible plan whose implied prices have a wrong sign gets None
a binding >= row's price must be at most zero, and a negative one is no reason to refuse
prices with the right signs still refuse the plan when a product it leaves out has a positive reduced cost
